title: Rabbi Yaakov of Nehar Pekod
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He was a student of Ravina, as in Sanhedrin 69a: he sat before Ravina and spoke in the name of Rav Huna, son of Rav Yehoshua. He spoke in Ravina’s name in Ketubot 93a and 98b, and Bava Batra 157b.
And we find in Ketubot 33b that he said in the name of Rava. And he is mentioned in Avodah Zarah 60a, 72a; Zevachim 6a, 8b.
In Chullin 107a, he is said to have prepared a washing vessel holding a quarter-log.

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Sanhedrin 69a explicitly calls Yaakov of Nehar Pekod Rabbi and spells out Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua. Chullin 107a instead calls Yaakov Rav and says he prepared a quarter-log vessel. These are the named passages’ title forms, not a global harmonization.
